targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "Total Events" FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))

SELECT count(*) AS "Completed Runs" FROM events WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed' AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')

  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e

SELECT sum((metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float) AS "Total Time" FROM events WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed' AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)

SELECT avg((metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float) AS "Avg Duration" FROM events WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed' AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)

SELECT sum((metadata->>'tokens_used')::bigint) AS "Total Tokens" FROM events WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed' AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')

SELECT avg(span_seconds) AS "Avg Wall-Clock Time" FROM (
  SELECT correlation_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(event_timestamp) - min(event_timestamp))) AS span_seconds
  FROM events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))  GROUP BY correlation_id
) t

SELECT skill_name, count(*) AS count FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      )) GROUP BY skill_name ORDER BY skill_name

SELECT
          event_timestamp AS "time",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-specify' THEN (metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float END) AS "specify",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-plan' THEN (metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float END) AS "plan",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-tasks' THEN (metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float END) AS "tasks",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-implement' THEN (metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float END) AS "implement"
        FROM events
        WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed' AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))
        ORDER BY event_timestamp

SELECT
          event_timestamp AS "time",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-specify' THEN (metadata->>'tokens_used')::bigint END) AS "specify",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-plan' THEN (metadata->>'tokens_used')::bigint END) AS "plan",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-tasks' THEN (metadata->>'tokens_used')::bigint END) AS "tasks",
          (CASE WHEN skill_name = 'speckit-implement' THEN (metadata->>'tokens_used')::bigint END) AS "implement"
        FROM events
        WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed' AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))
        ORDER BY event_timestamp

SELECT "Ticket", "Time Used (s)" FROM (
          SELECT
            ticket_id AS "Ticket",
            sum((metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float) AS "Time Used (s)",
            max(event_timestamp) AS "Last Activity"
          FROM events
          WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed' AND ticket_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))
          GROUP BY ticket_id
        ) sub
        ORDER BY "Last Activity" DESC
        LIMIT 10

panels.title: Time Used by Ticket (10 Most Recent)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
          elem->>'server' AS "Server",
          sum((elem->>'calls')::int) AS "Calls",
          sum((elem->>'tokens')::bigint) AS "Tokens",
          count(DISTINCT events.id) AS "Events",
          count(DISTINCT events.correlation_id) AS "Specs"
        FROM events, jsonb_array_elements(metadata->'mcp_usage') AS elem
        WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))
        GROUP BY "Server"
        ORDER BY "Tokens" DESC

SELECT
          elem->>'mode' AS "Mode",
          sum((elem->>'turns')::int) AS "Turns",
          sum((elem->>'tokens')::bigint) AS "Tokens",
          count(DISTINCT events.id) AS "Events",
          count(DISTINCT events.correlation_id) AS "Specs"
        FROM events, jsonb_array_elements(metadata->'mode_usage') AS elem
        WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))
        GROUP BY "Mode"
        ORDER BY "Tokens" DESC

SELECT
          correlation_id AS "Correlation ID",
          max(ticket_id) AS "Ticket",
          max(metadata->>'summary') FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'speckit_specify_started') AS "Summary",
          array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT skill_name ORDER BY skill_name), ', ') AS "Skills",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type LIKE '%_started') AS "Runs",
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type LIKE '%_completed') AS "Completed",
          sum((metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float) AS "Total Duration (s)",
          sum((metadata->>'tokens_used')::bigint) AS "Total Tokens",
          max(event_timestamp) AS "Last Activity"
        FROM events
        WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))
        GROUP BY correlation_id
        ORDER BY max(event_timestamp) DESC

SELECT
          event_timestamp AS "Time",
          event_type AS "Event",
          skill_name AS "Skill",
          (metadata->>'duration_seconds')::float AS "Duration (s)",
          ticket_id AS "Ticket",
          (metadata->>'tokens_used')::bigint AS "Tokens",
          correlation_id AS "Correlation ID",
          repository AS "Repo",
          branch AS "Branch",
          id AS "ID"
        FROM events
        WHERE $__timeFilter(event_timestamp)
  AND ('${skill:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR skill_name = '${skill:raw}')
  AND ('${correlation_id:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR correlation_id = '${correlation_id:raw}')
  AND ('${ticket:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR ticket_id = '${ticket:raw}')
  AND ('${repository:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR repository = '${repository:raw}')
  AND ('${mcp_server:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mcp_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'server' = '${mcp_server:raw}'
      ))
  AND ('${mode:raw}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(metadata->'mode_usage','[]'::jsonb)) e
        WHERE e->>'mode' = '${mode:raw}'
      ))
        ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC
        LIMIT 100
